purpose: Bounded characterization of the real-data L_G gradient non-bitwise behaviour found by E04 production qualification 1d026252743d077b483b5d451002e5b406c1caef (K.real_data_gradient_repeatability, 41/42). Diagnostic only: no RunContext, no checkpoint, no run root, no scientific seed, no VAL, no TEST, no graph / placement / optimizer / data / seed / environment change.

inputs_fixed.qualification_seed_note: The owner directive names 'the existing qualification seed 314159'. The existing production qualification seed is 60904 (production_io.QUALIFICATION_SEED; validate_mode_seed refuses any other). 314159 is only the M6D3e reference-construction seed used for the graph-signature comparison. 60904 is used; no seed is changed.
inputs_fixed.feed: production_runner.Feed: D4 PairStream / D7 HardStream (seed 60904), feed pack db1908d56efb23758fee49f88d2158374b85572a213a269419881bd02037520b, pre-pass 274a4b0a52077cae18a5477565429410b24479236e8835415cf0eb783f026279, real TRAIN faces only
inputs_fixed.update_sequence: production_runner.Controller.iteration (per step: BN update collections, then apply with that step's losses) -- the frozen scientific update sequence
inputs_fixed.environment: gpat-m6-e03, E04 training precision environment, PYTHONHASHSEED=60904, E04 training lock except the D9 driver version

design.process_rule: three independent clean python -B processes, run sequentially (one GPU process at a time) from the same committed checkout
design.gradient_probe_tensors: per-loss gradients L_depth, L_G, L_P, L_R, L_S, L_H (G variables) and L_D (D variables); the applied step gradients step_gradients[1] (G, Eq.23), [2] (D, L_D), [3] (G, Eq.24); all evaluated at the iteration-start state S_t on the iteration input X_t before Step 1
design.minibatch_reference: the same L_G and step-1 gradients at the same state S_t on the next real TRAIN batch X_{t+1}, produced by a separate look-ahead Feed (same seed, separate RandomState objects) that never touches the controller feed; X_{t+1} must equal the batch the controller later draws
design.per_iteration_diagnostic: before Step 1 of every iteration: the step-1 applied gradient and the L_G gradient are fetched twice at (S_t, X_t); the full state before and after the diagnostic fetches must be bit-identical (diagnostics never perturb the trajectory)
design.operation_level: iteration 0, every process: (a) one FULL_TRACE RunMetadata of all gradient tensors -> executed device of every graph operation; (b) first-divergence localization: every fetchable numeric tensor in the ancestor closure of all gradient tensors is fetched 3 times (each op together with its inputs in the same run) and sha256-compared; an op is a variation origin when an output differs across repeats while every input is bit-identical
design.bn_cancelled_biases: structural, from the graph before any result: a convolution bias whose every forward BiasAdd consumer feeds only training-mode FusedBatchNorm ops (its exact gradient is zero and it cannot change any forward output); reported separately, excluded from the functional parameter groups
design.outputs:
/tmp/gpat_e04_d10/

/ on the GPU host, then copied read-only to /qualification/e04_production/d10_probe_/ with SHA256SUMS
design.smoke_runs: a --smoke run (3 iterations) may be used only to exercise the code path; smoke outputs are refused by the analysis and never interpreted

C1_contract_identity.rule: exact equality across P1, P2, P3 at every iteration of: pair rows and passes, hard scales and keep, input sha256 of all five arrays, counters before and after every iteration (global_iteration, phase, lr_G, lr_D), the sequence of session calls (fetch names and feed keys), the four Adam beta-power accumulators after every iteration (optimizer application count), look-ahead batch equality; and of the construction signature (= 61f1ed58..., 11315 ops), the initial state sha256 and the set of executed graph operations in the iteration-0 trace, compared by recursive structural signature (op type, attributes, requested device, input signatures; name only for stateful ops) because TF's classic-optimizer common-subexpression elimination keeps an arbitrary member of each class of identical ops (smoke runs showed executed op names differing across processes, signature sets equal); runtime-inserted _Send/_Recv transfer nodes are excluded

C2_finite.rule: every loss, every fetched gradient and every state value of every process at every iteration is finite

C3_localization.rule: (a) iteration 0, across processes: all in-run step-1 losses, every per-loss gradient except L_G, and the step-2 and step-3 gradients at the start state are bit-identical; (b) at every gradient-probe iteration in every process, in-process repeats of every per-loss gradient except L_G and of the step-2 and step-3 gradients are bit-identical; (c) every variation origin found by the operation-level localization (union over processes) is of type ResizeBilinearGrad or ScatterNd, executes on the GPU, and has fully observable inputs; (d) every warp GatherNd and every forward ResizeBilinear executes on the CPU

C4_fixed_state_magnitude.rule: at every gradient-probe iteration in every process, for the concatenated L_G gradient and the concatenated step-1 applied gradient: max over repeats ||g_r - g_0||_2 <= 1e-3 * ||g(S_t, X_{t+1}) - g(S_t, X_t)||_2
C4_fixed_state_magnitude.rationale: the numerical repeat variation must be at least three orders of magnitude below the minibatch sampling variation that the scientific procedure itself injects at the same state

C5_trajectory_parameters.rule: for every process pair and every snapshot t >= 1, separately for the functional G trainables and the functional D trainables: ||theta_a(t) - theta_b(t)||_2 <= min(u_a(t), u_b(t)), where u_p(t) is the median single-iteration update norm ||theta_p(s) - theta_p(s-1)||_2 over s in [max(1, t-9), t]
C5_trajectory_parameters.rationale: after up to 1000 iterations the independently started trajectories must remain closer to each other than one training iteration moves the model

C6_trajectory_losses.rule: for every process pair and every in-run loss (11 values per iteration), over the final window t in [900, 1000): median |L_a(t) - L_b(t)| <= 1e-2 * median over both processes of |L_p(t) - L_p(t-1)|; when that sampling scale is exactly zero the difference must be exactly zero
C6_trajectory_losses.rationale: cross-process loss differences must stay two orders of magnitude below the iteration-to-iteration loss change caused by minibatch sampling

descriptive_only: per-variable gradient error distributions (absolute, relative L2, cosine, ULP, scale-aware max|d| / max|g|), BN-cancelled biases separately
Adam m / v, BN moving mean / variance deviations (absolute and normalized)
deviation growth: log-log slope of the parameter deviation over snapshots t >= 10, and per-iteration loss differences

decision_rule.D10_SUPPORTED: C1, C2, C3, C4, C5 and C6 all pass
decision_rule.STOP_AND_REPORT: any of C1, C2, C3 fails
decision_rule.DECISION_REPORT_NOT_SUPPORTED: C1-C3 pass and any of C4, C5, C6 fails (bounded evidence does not support D10)
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_change: thresholds, probe length, process count, probe iterations and windows are fixed by this file and by tools/e04_d10_analysis.py at the commit that adds them; they are not changed after any result is seen
